content.comment_body: Hello. Is it possible to create a ladder diagram program directly using the [product_name] device itself, without relying on [product_name] software? From what I understand, it seems this is only feasible through a computer and not with the device alone.

Hi, If you wish to program the [product_name] unit directly, ladder logic (LAD) cannot be created this way. Function block diagram (FBD) programming on the device also differs from what’s available in the software. With the software, you can start programming wherever you choose, but on the device, you must begin at an output and progress toward an input. Overall, it’s not straightforward—using the software is recommended. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unsure if ladder logic programming can be done directly on the [product_name] device rather than through the accompanying software. The responses clarify that entering ladder logic is only possible using a computer and the appropriate software, not through the device itself. There are notable differences in how programming works on the hardware versus the software, which might reduce the convenience for some users seeking direct device input.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to program ladder logic directly on the [product_name] device without requiring separate software.
